ex.en: Scientists warn that the ozone layer is recovering more slowly than expected.
ex.zh: 科学家警告，臭氧层的恢复速度比预期更慢。

words.note: ozone layer 指臭氧层；亦见 ozone depletion 臭氧消耗。

ex.en: The project was postponed for an indefinite period because of the funding cuts.
ex.zh: 由于资金削减，该项目被无限期推迟。

words.note: in-（不）+ definite（确定的）→ 不确定的；副词 indefinitely。

ex.en: The government sent troops to help the victims of the natural disaster.
ex.zh: 政府派兵帮助这场自然灾害的受灾民众。

words.note: 常与 natural 连用；形容词 disastrous 表「灾难性的」。

ex.en: Building the dam may damage the ecology of the whole river valley.
ex.zh: 修建大坝可能破坏整个河谷的生态。

words.note: eco-（生态）+ -logy（学科）→ 生态学；形容词 ecological。

ex.en: The factory was rebuilt with minimal cost and almost no delay.
ex.zh: 工厂以最低成本重建，几乎没有延误。

words.note: minimal 强调「最低限度」；minimum 多指最低值，反义 maximal。

ex.en: They held a small cocktail party to celebrate the new contract.
ex.zh: 他们举办了一个小型鸡尾酒会庆祝新合同。

words.note: cocktail 除「鸡尾酒」外还指混合物，如 a cocktail of drugs。

ex.en: Adding fresh herbs can greatly enhance the flavour of the soup.
ex.zh: 加入新鲜香草能大大提升汤的风味。

words.note: enhance 强调提升品质或价值，不用于人；名词 enhancement。

ex.en: By convention the chairman opens the meeting with a short speech.
ex.zh: 按照惯例，主席以简短发言宣布会议开始。

words.note: 表「会议」时可数；表「惯例」时常用复数 conventions。

ex.en: Regular exercise lowers the risk of heart disease and diabetes.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可降低患心脏病和糖尿病的风险。

words.note: 指具体疾病；染上疾病说 contract 或 catch a disease。

ex.en: Milk and green vegetables are rich sources of calcium.
ex.zh: 牛奶和绿色蔬菜是钙的丰富来源。

words.note: 常用 rich in calcium 表「富含钙」，deficiency 指缺乏。

ex.en: Notwithstanding the bad weather, the outdoor concert went ahead as planned.
ex.zh: 尽管天气恶劣，露天音乐会仍按计划举行。

words.note: 较正式，可作介词或副词，相当于 despite / in spite of。

ex.en: The guard stopped the man on suspicion of stealing from the shop.
ex.zh: 保安因该男子涉嫌在店内行窃而拦住了他。

words.note: 常见搭配 arouse/raise suspicion；形容词 suspicious。

ex.en: Customers can return any purchase within thirty days of delivery.
ex.zh: 顾客可在收货后三十天内退回任何所购商品。

words.note: 作名词指「所购之物」，比 buy 正式；purchasing power 指购买力。

ex.en: His refusal to sign the contract surprised everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 他拒绝签署合同，这让在场的人都很惊讶。

words.note: refusal 后接 to do，不接 of doing；动词 refuse 用法相同。

ex.en: The cafe now uses disposable cups made of recycled paper.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆现在使用再生纸制的一次性杯子。

words.note: disposable income 指扣除税费后的可支配收入，经济类高频。

ex.en: A new road was built to bypass the crowded town centre.
ex.zh: 新修了一条路以绕过拥挤的市中心。

words.note: 可作名词「旁道」；作动词表「绕过」，如 bypass the rules。

ex.en: Most computer chips are made from thin layers of silicon.
ex.zh: 大多数计算机芯片由薄薄的硅层制成。

words.note: silicon 是元素「硅」；silicon chip 指硅芯片，科技话题高频。

ex.en: The professor explained the theory with great clarity and patience.
ex.zh: 教授以极大的清晰度和耐心讲解了这个理论。

words.note: 形容词 clear 的名词形式；with clarity 相当于 clearly，更正式。

ex.en: The charity raised enough funds to rebuild the village school.
ex.zh: 这家慈善机构筹到足够资金重建村里的学校。

words.note: funds 复数表「资金」；作动词表「资助」，如 fund the project。

ex.en: It is typical of him to arrive late without calling.
ex.zh: 不打电话就迟到，这是他的典型做法。

words.note: be typical of sb/sth 表「具有…的典型特征」；名词 type。

ex.en: She was the first recipient of the award for young scientists.
ex.zh: 她是该青年科学家奖的首位获得者。

words.note: 常与 donor（捐赠者）相对，指「接受者、受赠者」。

ex.en: Many Commonwealth countries share English as an official language.
ex.zh: 许多英联邦国家把英语作为官方语言之一。

words.note: common（共同）+ wealth（财富）；首字母大写常指英联邦。

ex.en: This energy-saving lamp uses only nine watts of electricity.
ex.zh: 这种节能灯只消耗九瓦电。

words.note: 功率单位，符号 W；kilowatt-hour 即日常说的「度」。

ex.en: The classroom buzzed with excitement before the holiday began.
ex.zh: 假期开始前，教室里一片兴奋的嗡嗡声。

words.note: 拟声词，指蜜蜂般的嗡嗡声；give sb a buzz 口语指打电话。

ex.en: The city plans to finance the new library through private donations.
ex.zh: 该市计划通过私人捐款为新图书馆提供资金。

words.note: 作名词指财政金融，作动词表「为…筹资」；形容词 financial。

ex.en: The company incurred heavy losses after the factory closed.
ex.zh: 工厂关闭后，公司蒙受了严重损失。

words.note: incur 后多接 loss、cost、debt 等，表「招致、蒙受」。

ex.en: The road is notorious for accidents during the rainy season.
ex.zh: 这条路因雨季事故频发而臭名昭著。

words.note: be notorious for sth；带贬义，与褒义的 famous 相对。

ex.en: The assassination attempt failed when the guard spotted the gunman.
ex.zh: 警卫发现枪手，暗杀企图失败了。

words.note: assassinate 指暗杀要人；注意双写 s，名词 assassination。

ex.en: The clinic offers free check-ups for mothers and their infants.
ex.zh: 该诊所为母亲和婴儿提供免费体检。

words.note: 比 baby 正式；infant mortality 指婴儿死亡率，新闻高频。

ex.en: The thyroid gland controls how quickly the body uses energy.
ex.zh: 甲状腺控制人体消耗能量的速度。

words.note: 常与身体部位连用：thyroid gland 甲状腺、sweat gland 汗腺。
